description: This is a shell script used for initializing and booting a live root filesystem in a Linux environment. It handles mounting filesystems, detecting removable media, setting up device nodes, and switching root to the target root filesystem image.

methods.name: udev_daemon
methods.description: Checks for an available udev daemon executable in common locations and returns the path if found.

methods.name: early_setup
methods.description: Sets up necessary filesystems and starts udev daemon.

methods.name: read_args
methods.description: Reads and processes command-line arguments or kernel command line parameters.

methods.name: mount_and_boot
methods.description: Mounts the root image, handles union filesystems if necessary, and switches root to the new filesystem.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Prints an error message and drops into an interactive shell.
